messages:
lex: Heads-up: we need a curated benchpack + manifest for the launch narrative. Not just raw samples — we need metadata so marketing can justify claims (coldstart/warmup, quantized variants, seq len buckets).

lex: TL;DR asks: 1) canonical manifest.csv with columns (file, prompt_type, seq_len, seed, quant, warmup_policy, model_tag, expected_percentile_ms, notes) 2) runs for FP16, 8bit, and 4bit quantized variants 3) coldstart vs warmed traces + 99th/95th/median latencies 4) seed/pinned model versions so results are reproducible 5) small example payloads attached inline we can link in the blog. @chris @maria can you confirm? :pray:

chris: Yep, makes sense. A couple quick clarifiers: what sample size per bucket are you expecting? And do you want the warmup to be the same policy we use for internal perf dashboards (5 warmup reqs per worker)?

lex: Target sample size = 200 requests per seq_len bucket (short/medium/long). Warmup = 5 per worker is fine. For coldstart please include the first 100 requests after a full service restart.

chris: Got it. I'll pin model tags in the run config: e.g. redwood/open-llama-7b-v2-20260201-fp16, and produce variants: fp16, quant8, quant4. We'll include RNG seed in the manifest.

maria: We'll also add a small README.md with repro steps and the exact CLI we used. Example run command I'll use: 
```
./tools/bench_runner --manifest manifest.csv --model-tag redwood/open-llama-7b-v2-20260201-fp16 --quant variant --out results/<job-id>.csv
```
I'll mark the job with a stable job id and post the URL.

sam: Uploading a draft manifest now to the shared bucket. Manifest columns follow lex's list plus a column "payload_sha256" for sample provenance. Example row: 
```csv
file,prompt_type,seq_len,seed,quant,warmup_policy,model_tag,expected_percentile_ms,notes,payload_sha256
short_001.json,completion,32,42,fp16,5w,redwood/open-llama-7b-v2-20260201-fp16,<=50,chat-like prompt,abc123...
```
Link: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/benchpack/manifest-draft.csv

jia: Can we also get a tiny human-readable sample bundle (3 prompts per bucket) that we can paste into the post? Prefer short prompts that show coherent completions.

maria: Yes — I'll include a samples/ directory with three curated prompts per bucket and add an attribution file (why these were chosen).

chris: One more ask from runtime: please flag any prompt that triggers long internal past-key-values (>1M tokens) or multimodal hooks. We'll tag those in a column so marketing doesn't accidentally claim low-latency for pathological cases.

lex: Good call. Add a "pathology_flag" column. Also can the runtime run produce a small heatmap for coldstart vs warmed percentile deltas? We want a single PNG and the raw CSV.

runtime-bot: Job queued: job-id=job_2026_1759428601_1. Estimated run time ~ 45m. Will post results to https://redwood-internal/runs/job_2026_1759428601_1 when complete.

maria: Starting run now on dedicated pool (reserved). Will run fp16 -> quant8 -> quant4 sequentially, with coldstart captures and warmed captures. I will upload results/* and a consolidated summary JSON.

chris: After runs, can you also compute per-bucket 50/95/99 latencies and per-token cost estimate (tokenization used, effective tokens per request)? Marketing wants a cost footnote.

maria: Yep, adding cost columns: tokens_in, tokens_out, est_cost_usd (using our hosted rates baseline).

runtime-bot: Job update: job-id=job_2026_1759428601_1 started on pool=d-ed100, step=fp16-run (0/3 complete). ETA ~ 42m.

lex: Amazing — once you have the PNG + consolidated CSV, can you ping this thread and drop a short 3-line blurb we can quote? e.g., "median latency X ms, 95th Y ms, cost Z per 1k tokens on quant4".

sam: I uploaded manifest-v1 and samples bundle to s3 and added checksums to the manifest. Link above updated.

maria: Run finished. Uploaded: results/job_2026_1759428601_1_summary.csv, results/job_2026_1759428601_1_heatmap.png, results/job_2026_1759428601_1_raw.zip. Summary row example included in the CSV and manifest updated with job_id.

maria: Quoted blurb for marketing: "On redwood/open-llama-7b-v2 (pinned 20260201), median latency for 32-token prompts: 48ms (fp16), 52ms (quant8), 58ms (quant4). 95th percentile for long prompts (1024 tokens) was 420ms (quant4). Estimated cost per 1k tokens: $0.12 (fp16), $0.09 (quant8), $0.065 (quant4)."

jia: Perfect — that's exactly what we need. I'll draft the post with those numbers and link to the manifest + sample bundle. Please keep the manifest immutable; if you need to change it, version the file.

lex: Thanks team — this is super helpful. If anything else pops up, @maria or @chris please escalate here. :thumbsup:
